verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a work-management platform like ClickUp, so the axis applies. The pack only shows per-item API operations (create, update and manage tasks), filtering, MCP search and one-time migration imports. None of these documents a bulk-edit or batch operation across many items. Per-task API calls are developer building blocks, and Asana/Jira imports are an adjacent migration feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
